summary: Recommend fast track. Records the agency obtained from the trauma hospital and the rehabilitation hospital show a complete (AIS A) T10 spinal cord injury with no movement in either leg from 01/08/2026 through the 06/18/2026 visit, more than 3 continuous months. Better wheelchair mobility since May is not a return of leg function.

findings.quote: ASIA Impairment Scale A, unchanged from admission
